 Catch the K-pop Sensation KATSEYE in Singapore This February
 3 hours ago The upcoming 'The Wildworld Tour' marks the debut concert for Katseye in Singapore.
 With two members currently on hiatus, speculation remains on whether all members of Katseye will be reunited on the tour. 
 'The Wildworld Tour' by Katseye will be held at the Singapore Indoor Stadium on 10 February 2027. 
 KATSEYE bring their WILDWORLD TOUR to Singapore for one night only.
 A gnarly new addition is shaking up Singapore’s 2027 concert calendar. The Grammy-nominated girl group KATSEYE will take their ‘The Wildworld Tour’ to Singapore on 10 February 2027 for a one-night-only performance, featuring live tracks from their Billboard 200 number one extended play Wild . Fans can also expect performances of their hit singles when the girls hit the stage at Singapore Indoor Stadium. 
 This appearance marks KATSEYE’s first concert in Singapore, then takes members Daniela, Lara, Megan, and Yoonchae to cities such as Bangkok, Cebu, Hong Kong, Sydney and Taipei. Two members, Sophia and Manon, who earlier this year announced their hiatuses from the group’s activities for personal reasons, were notably absent during KATSEYE’s halftime set at the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show on 13 October. Speculation now surrounds whether the duo will be reunited with the active members next year. The tour will also be a homecoming for Megan, whose mother is Singaporean. 
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Live Nation Asia (@livenationasia) 
 KATSEYE formed in 2024, following rounds of worldwide auditions and over 120,000 applicants, all competing to participate in the reality series The Debut: Dream Academy – the same company behind BTS, TXT and LE SSERAFIM. KATSEYE’s current members were the top contenders emerging from this fierce competition. The members come from the Philippines, South Korea, Switzerland, and the United States. The group’s name is a reference to the gemstone chrysoberyl.
 Since their debut, the girl group have released three extended plays, SIS (Soft Is Strong) , Beautiful Chaos , and Wild . Fans of the group, who call themselves “Eyekons”, and anyone within proximity of a radio, will undoubtedly find the catchy tunes of their singles such as “Gabriela”, “Gnarly” and “Pinky Up” familiar. But in 2026, the group truly made a name for themselves, winning all the awards they were nominated for at the American Music Awards while also receiving nominations at the Grammys for Best New Artist and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance.
 Aside from their solo global tours, Katseye have also participated in music festivals such as Coachella and Lollapalooza, collaborated on an exclusive track “Iconic by Mistake” with fellow record label mates Le Sserafim and Illit, released two documentary films charting their journeys, partnered with brands such as Fendi on fashion campaigns, and appeared as characters in a video game. 
 Tickets to see KATSEYE in Singapore on ‘The Wildworld Tour’ will be available for pre-sale to Eyekons Weverse Global Membership holders on 10 November from 12pm, before general sales for the public open from 13 November at 10am. 
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium, Stadium Walk, Kallang, Singapore 
 When: Wednesday 10 February 2027 
 Contact: ticketmaster.sg
